title: Zesty Monsoon Dutch Egg Spring Rolls
description: A pungent and shattering monsoon Dutch dish featuring egg rolls cooked in a clay pot on a raclette grill, with Mediterranean-friendly flavors. This unique recipe combines the best of Dutch and Mediterranean cuisine.
instructions: Cook the eggs in a clay pot on the raclette grill over medium heat until the whites are set and the yolks are cooked to desired doneness.
Chop the cooked eggs into small pieces and set aside.
Layer the spring roll wrappers with the chopped eggs, feta cheese, kalamata olives, artichoke hearts, sun-dried tomatoes, and fresh parsley.
Drizzle the olive oil over the layers and sprinkle with monsoon spice blend.
Roll the spring rolls tightly and place them on the raclette grill.
Cook the spring rolls for 2-3 minutes on each side, until crispy and golden brown.
Melt the raclette cheese on top of the spring rolls and serve immediately.
Serve the Zesty Monsoon Dutch Egg Spring Rolls hot with a side of Mediterranean salad or bread.
Store any leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
